title: Higher direct images commute with bounded-below filtered colimits
statement:
Let $g\colon Y\to Z$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes, $A$ a sheaf of
rings on $Y_{\mathrm{proét}}$, and $(K_i^\bullet)$ a filtered diagram of complexes of
$A$-modules vanishing in degrees below a fixed $a$. Then for every $q$ the natural map
$\varinjlim_iR^qg_*K_i^\bullet\to R^qg_*(\varinjlim_iK_i^\bullet)$ of sheaves on $Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$
is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the existing module-valued theorem det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image with X=Y, its target Y=Z, f=g and R=A. Its canonical comparison is invertible in sheaves of modules over g_*A, and the displayed colimit.desc is the corresponding colimit.post after localization and higher direct image. The underlying-sheaf functor SheafOfModules.toSheaf preserves colimits by the source-library theorem CategoryTheory.moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful and the sheafification preservation instance. Therefore the underlying comparison, which is definitionally colimit.post for moduleComplexHigherDirectImage, is invertible.
